> ⚠️ DO NOT use this form for undisclosed or exploitable vulnerabilities.

## Publicly safe description

Describe the security concern without providing an exploitable proof of concept.

## Affected component

Which SavannaGuard component is affected?

## Affected version

Which version or commit is affected?

## Security impact

What could an attacker potentially achieve?

## Suggested mitigation

If known, describe a possible fix.

## Additional information

Do not include credentials, private keys, personal data, or other secrets.
